answer: Each new agent must post an onyx-denominated bond that unlocks only after three established peers independently solve a unique challenge drawn from a public reef of randomness published at network dawn. Concurrent registrations that share the same ASN or hardware fingerprint cluster force the bond to scale as O(n^{2}). A farm therefore cannot amortize: every extra identity multiplies both locked capital and the non-replayable attestation load that must be performed live, so the marginal cost of the nth clone rises faster than any linear reward.
